scope: The six latest R8C N/S/E/SE/SW/W world MP4 files were opened and reviewed as actual continuous playback in the existing planning conversation. Each file was decoded across 120 frames, 24 fps, 5 seconds, including five cycles, both support windows, F11->F12 and F23->next F00 boundaries. This is capture-only evidence and is not an eight-direction package or production-promotion review.

promotion.remaining_gate: Godot runtime integration, eight-direction sector/package gate, and independent Ponytail FULL gate

specific_findings.gait: All six directions read as actual directional forward walking with stance-swing alternation; no in-place tap dance, root-only skate, central leg crossing, or persistent duck-foot/out-toed gait was observed.
specific_findings.scale_and_volume: Leg length and width remain stable across the full clips; no rubber-leg stretch, non-uniform pumping, barrel-calf expansion, or waist snap was observed.
specific_findings.foot_and_ground: No blocking 90-degree ankle break, boot inversion, gross foot snap, visible ground penetration, or floating support sole was observed.
specific_findings.sole_and_handoff: Both support windows remain visibly locked; F11->F12 and F23->F00 handoffs are continuous, with no root reset, marker reversal, or long-step/short-catch-up repetition.
specific_findings.raster_cadence: The R7 stop-and-catch-up defect is not visible in R8C. Small 1px/2px raster micro-cadence remains non-blocking; SE/SW have slightly more visible diagonal modulation.
specific_findings.composite: Torso, pelvis, coat, weapon, leg ordering, seams, green/alpha edges, and silhouette remain stable; no flicker, green wedge/pinhole, halo, or z-order pop was observed.

direction_notes.N: Rear view reads as forward travel with alternating support; low heel/toe roll and small counter-motion are non-blocking.
direction_notes.S: Front view reads as forward travel; depth separation of the feet is weaker in some phases, but there is no crossing or persistent out-toe.
direction_notes.E: Side view reads as forward travel; leg overlap and low swing-foot clearance create a mild flat shuffle impression without a blocker.
direction_notes.SE: Diagonal forward travel and alternation are clear; mild diagonal cadence modulation and depth ambiguity are non-blocking.
direction_notes.SW: Diagonal forward travel and alternation are clear; stance is slightly wide and foot roll is restrained, both non-blocking.
direction_notes.W: Side view reads as forward travel; leg overlap, low swing-foot clearance, and small foot roll are non-blocking.

non_blocking_polish: Low heel-to-toe roll and restrained swing-foot clearance.
Small pelvis/torso counter-motion; a somewhat rigid tactical or marching read.
N/S 1px-to-2px raster micro-cadence and SE/SW diagonal speed modulation.
E/W side-view leg overlap and flat shuffle impression.
Subpixel translation causing approximately 1px edge softness variation.
